# temps_monitor (Resource)

An uptime monitor that probes a project environment's URL. Show it on a `temps_status_page`.

Only `check_path` can change in place; the API cannot update the other attributes, so changing them replaces the monitor.

Required API key permissions: `status_page:create`, `status_page:read`, `status_page:write`, `status_page:delete`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_monitor" "web" {
  project_id             = temps_project.web.id
  environment_id         = data.temps_environment.production.id
  name                   = "web"
  monitor_type           = "health"
  check_path             = "/healthz"
  check_interval_seconds = 60
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (Number) ID of the environment to probe; it must belong to `project_id`.
- `name` (String) Monitor name.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `check_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks, at least 30 (the server raises lower values to 30, so they are rejected here to avoid a permanent diff). Changing it replaces the monitor.
- `check_path` (String) Path to probe, for example `/healthz`.
- `monitor_type` (String) `web` probes the environment URL (plus `check_path`); `health` probes `/health` unless `check_path` is set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric monitor ID.
- `monitor_url` (String) Full URL being probed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_monitor.web 9
```
